certificate.description: Required. The base64 encoded string representing the public certificate.

certificateRevocationListUrl.description: The URL of the certificate revocation list.

deltaCertificateRevocationListUrl.description: The URL contains the list of all revoked certificates since the last time a full certificate revocaton list was created.

isRootAuthority.description: Required. true if the trusted certificate is a root authority, false if the trusted certificate is an intermediate authority.

issuer.description: The issuer of the certificate, calculated from the certificate value. Read-only.

issuerSki.description: The subject key identifier of the certificate, calculated from the certificate value. Read-only.
